What we haul away

One crew, one truck, and a list that covers most of what ends up in a garage, a basement or a back yard. Pick the job below to see what we take, or book now and tell us what's going. If it's heavy, awkward or just in the way, ask us.

Junk removalAnything from one couch to a full truck, loaded by us. Garage and basement clean outsClear the floor and get the room back. Demo projectsSheds, decks and tear-outs taken down and hauled off. FurnitureCouches, dressers, desks and dining sets. AppliancesFridges, washers, dryers and stoves. MattressesMattresses, box springs and bed frames, any size. Yard wasteBrush, branches, leaves and clean-up piles.

Do you come to my town?

Probably. We cover towns on both sides of the Massachusetts and New Hampshire line, and every one of them starts at the same price. You pay for how much of the truck your junk fills. Add photos when you book and we confirm the price before the day, so nothing changes in your driveway.

From booking to bare floor

You book

Pick your town, your load and a day. It takes a couple of minutes online, and you can add photos of the junk so we know exactly what's coming.

We confirm

We check the job and lock in your time. Shawn looks over every booking and gets back to you to confirm the time and the price, so there are no surprises on the day.

We haul

We load it, take it and leave the space clear. You point, we carry, and anything still in good shape goes to donation instead of the dump.
